investment_theses.thesis: Long UST/DXY (US dollar strength) through Q3 2026; macro deterioration (weak labor data, geopolitical escalation) drives safe-haven demand despite G7 temporary oil releases.
supporting_signals: September jobs print (29k added, 4.2% unemployment) is worst data of cycle, signaling Fed cuts but initial dollar floor holds
G7 diesel reserves are tactical, temporary; Russia bridge strikes + Houthi escalation create supply tail-risk that raises real rates
Cboe VIX initiatives and bond volatility suggest institutional de-risking into cash and Treasuries
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed forced to cut faster than priced; fiscal spending (Trump admin stimulus) reignites inflation and weakens DXY despite near-term labor softness.
investment_theses.expression: Long DXY (ICE Dollar Index ETF), short EUR/USD 1.08 short-term calls; or long USDC yield strategies (e.g., Aave USDC deposit rate vs. 3-month T-bills)
